reference.title: Flexible RAN Slicing in Open RAN With Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
reference.venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications

faithful_structural_elements: shuffled agent order each macro step
adaptations_for_common_environment: single parameter-shared PPO policy with slice identity in observation
three slice types instead of paper-specific tenant/slice population
two-dimensional per-slice action adds admission fraction to resource share
same 7-cell interference and queue dynamics as proposed method
raw projected per-slice dual ascent rather than exact MAPPOL implementation
warning: CMARS baseline_v1 had no dual updates and must not be used as constrained baseline.
bugfix: Persist Lagrange multipliers and 3000-macro-step cost accumulator across 300-step episode resets.
